trust_decision.summary: The decision 'is this JSON safe to embed inside a <script> element' is taken at output-encoding time, once per toScript() implementation: src/BaseType.php:163, src/Graph.php:1211 and src/MultiTypedEntity.php:1098 all json_encode with JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES only, so a '</script>' inside any property value terminates the element; the same three encoders are duplicated verbatim in the code-generator that writes src/ (generator/templates/static/BaseType.php:163, generator/templates/twig/Graph.php.twig:301, generator/templates/twig/MultiTypedEntity.php.twig:188).

landing_point.why: Every one of the ~1,600 generated types inherits toScript() from this abstract base (src/BaseType.php:12), and the advisory summary names toScript() output, so a reader who read only the summary opens BaseType first.

fix_sites.entry_point: BaseType::toScript() (also via __toString at src/BaseType.php:176-179, and via ReferencedType::toScript()/__toString() which delegate at src/ReferencedType.php:39-52); reached from every generated type, e.g. Schema::localBusiness()->toScript()
fix_sites.module_kind: public library API (abstract base class of all schema types)
public library API (independent multi-@type entity wrapper)

fix_sites.entry_point: composer generate / php generate.php -> GenerateCommand -> PackageGenerator -> Filesystem::cloneStaticFiles(), which copies this file byte-for-byte to src/BaseType.php (generator/Writer/Filesystem.php:48-62)
composer generate -> Filesystem::createBuilderClass() renders this Twig template into src/Graph.php (generator/Writer/Filesystem.php:84-87)
composer generate -> Filesystem::createBuilderClass() renders this Twig template into src/MultiTypedEntity.php (generator/Writer/Filesystem.php:89-92)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: generator/templates/static/BaseType.php:163 (plus generator/templates/twig/Graph.php.twig:301 and generator/templates/twig/MultiTypedEntity.php.twig:188) - a second, dev-only copy of the same encoders that is the real source of src/BaseType.php, src/Graph.php and src/MultiTypedEntity.php

O3_reason_to_dismiss: generator/ is maintainer-only tooling loaded through autoload-dev and only runs on `composer generate`, so a solver can argue the shipped runtime is fixed once src/ is patched and the template copies are not part of the published surface.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: toArray()/jsonSerialize() (and therefore json_encode($type), documented in README.md:100-104) must keep returning raw, unescaped values with unescaped slashes and unicode; only the <script> embedding may escape. An over-broad fix that escapes in setProperty()/serializeProperty()/toArray() breaks API consumers and the existing expectation that json_encode($type) equals json_encode($expected) with literal '<'/'>' values, and HTML-escaping the whole encoded body would also break the URL expectations in GraphTest.php:219-220.

O6_input_shapes: value inside a nested child Type (serialized through serializeProperty)
node value inside Graph and inside MultiTypedEntity
case and padding variants such as </SCRIPT > and the HTML comment opener <!-- (JSON_HEX_TAG escapes every < and > regardless of case, so the flag covers them)

O7_producer.where: generator/Writer/Filesystem.php:48-93 - cloneStaticFiles() copies generator/templates/static/* into src/ and createBuilderClass() renders the Graph/MultiTypedEntity Twig templates into src/, i.e. this builder produces the very classes the hidden check exercises

O8_uncovered_routes.route: toScript() assembles the whole <script ...> tag from nonceAttr(), which interpolates the value stored by the public BaseType::setNonce() (src/BaseType.php:57-62) into a double-quoted attribute without escaping; a quote breaks out of the attribute and a following </script> closes the element, so the tag is still injection-prone even after the JSON body is hex-escaped.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: nonce is a server-side CSP token configured by the developer, not untrusted schema content, and the advisory text only describes script break-out from property values.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, 4 lines above the fixed line

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Graph::nonceAttr() builds the same script-tag attribute from the value stored by Graph::setNonce() (src/Graph.php:1137) with no escaping.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: same argument: the nonce is developer-supplied CSP configuration rather than attacker-controlled schema data.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, 4 lines above the fixed line

O8_uncovered_routes.route: MultiTypedEntity::nonceAttr() builds the same script-tag attribute from the value stored by MultiTypedEntity::setNonce() (src/MultiTypedEntity.php:1010) with no escaping.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: same argument: the nonce is developer-supplied CSP configuration rather than attacker-controlled schema data.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, 4 lines above the fixed line

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a ReferencedType::toScript() that builds its own <script> tag instead of delegating to $this->type->toScript()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ReferencedType already re-implements toArray()/jsonSerialize()/__toString() for the wrapper case and was touched recently for @id resolution (commit c6b3d4d, CHANGELOG.md:9), so a maintainer working there could plausibly emit the tag itself and copy the encoder call without the HEX_TAG flag.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an attribute-escaping helper shared by nonceAttr() in the three tag-building classes
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the nonce attribute is constructed in the same small method family as toScript() and was originally written with the same trust assumption; a maintainer adding any further tag attribute (nonce, id, data-*) would add it here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a fourth generated class with its own toScript(), e.g. an ItemList/Payload builder template
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: every script-tag-emitting class in src/ comes from a template and Filesystem::createBuilderClass() already emits three of them (generator/Writer/Filesystem.php:77-93); adding one more template adds another unescaped copy that the runtime tests never touch.

O9_family: CWE-79 cross-site scripting - HTML script-context injection in generated ld+json output

O10_build.toolchain: Composer; php ^8.2 with ext-json; dev: pestphp/pest ^2.36 || ^3.0, twig/twig ^3.21, symfony/console ^6||^7, league/flysystem ^3, illuminate/collections ^10, friendsofphp/php-cs-fixer, graham-campbell/analyzer
O10_build.project_tests: Pest tests in tests/: BaseTypeTest.php (ld+json script tag, nonce attribute, toArray/json_encode expectations), GraphTest.php, MultiTypedEntityTest.php, GraphIdentifierTest.php, GeneratedTypeSmokeTest.php, AnalysisTest.php; run with vendor/bin/pest. No test covers generator/templates, and the generator itself is not exercised by the suite.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add JSON_HEX_TAG to src/BaseType::toScript() only (the class the report's example exercises), or string-replace '</script' in the encoded body instead of changing the encoder flags.

out_of_scope_notes: Nothing beyond this advisory's own protection was pursued; the nonce-attribute routes (O8) are reported as the same toScript() sink rather than as a separate advisory.

Generator regeneration (composer generate) fetches the schema.org JSON-LD release from raw.githubusercontent.com unless --local is used with a cache in generator/temp, which is gitignored and empty at the pinned commit.
unverified: Repo size in MB could not be measured without a shell; the tree holds 1,872 PHP files including ~1,600 generated type classes and 913 contract interfaces, so it is clearly above 5 MB and far below 1.5 GB, but the exact figure is unknown.

Whether the O8 nonce route falls inside the advisory's published scope is a judgement call: it is the same toScript() <script> tag, but an attribute-context break-out rather than a script-element break-out.
No latest release was supplied for this candidate, so present_in_latest for the O8 routes is unknown.

Not verified whether the hidden suite can exercise generator/templates offline; the static template could be loaded after renaming its class, but the project ships no such test and Twig rendering of the builder templates needs a fabricated type collection.
